Ensure complete confidentiality.

No AI model training.

No data you upload to or output from the product is ever used for training any AI model of any kind.

No third-party monitoring.

Neither Solve nor any third-party monitors your data; everything is sandboxed to you.

State-of-the-art encryption.

All data is encrypted in transit and stored on enterprise servers with AES-256 and TLS 1.3 encryption.

Industry-leading certification.

We adhere to the highest security standards, including ISO 42001, GDPR, and CCPA, and are SOC 2 certified.

All data stored and processed locally.

Choose where your data is stored and processed (e.g. US, Europe, etc.). The data never leaves your chosen jurisdiction.

Patent Application Drafting

Interactively draft applications with AI.

Full and partial application drafting while keeping the attorney in the driving seat every step of the way. Fit any workflow and any application type, including standalone patent applications, continuation patent applications, divisional patent applications, continuation-in-part patent applications, and design patent applications.

Request Demo

Customize the AI to your unique drafting style.

Customize the AI to your unique drafting style, and switch between different styles for different jurisdictions, technology fields, clients, and individual attorney preferences.

Request Demo

Handle figures, chemical structures, biological sequences, and more.

Generate, analyze, and edit figures, chemical structures, biological sequences, and more. Built for any and all practice groups and technology areas.

Patent Prosecution

Collaboratively draft responses with AI.

Collaborative office action response drafting, including generating complete office action responses aligned with your writing style, drafting complete claim listings and claim amendments, and built-in citations to source documents and case law.

Request Demo

AI analysis & suggestions.

Use AI to check the accuracy, validity, and shortcomings of objections and rejections, as well as prior art, and generate potential amendments and arguments to overcome objections and rejections.

Request Demo

Multi-source citations.

The AI will support its proposed office action response strategies with citations from multiple sources, including citations of file wrapper documents, as well as relevant case law.

Request Demo

Claim Charts

Interactively generate any chart with Solve.

Use our Charts tool to generate any claim chart, including invalidity claim charts, SEP claim charts, freedom-to-operate and clearance charts, infringement mappings, claim construction analyses, portfolio analyses, or extracting insights from thousands of documents.

Request Demo

Repeatable results.

Turn your firm and company knowledge and expertise into repeatable and reusable templates that can be shared and used across your team and organization.

Request Demo

Multi-source citations and transparent logic.

Each cell includes citations and columns can be expanded to show Solve’s logical reasoning when producing columns and outputs, ensuring trust and transparency.
